dependencyDirection: order -> payment (in-process PaymentWebhookStore + payment-providers lib); payment -X-> order

notifyUrlContract.normalization: base trimmed of whitespace and trailing '/', provider code normalized (trim -> lowercase -> '-' -> '_')
resolutionOrder: commerce_payment_notify_domain active default (exact organization row, then platform '0' row)
none: checkout/refund submission must log and rely on the compensation sweep
forbidden: hand-assembled path outside the notify_url module

refundNotifyCapability.submissionRule: refund_notify_url_for_channel: forward only for dedicated_url channels, never blank

intakeAuth.paymentWebhook: public — the PSP presents its own signature, never a platform token
intakeAuth.backendConfirmation: backend token + commerce.orders.fulfill; tenant/organization from the access-token request context only

pipeline: normalize_event_identity (provider id, else sha256 fingerprint fallback)
payment applied_status dispatch | refund status dispatch | unsupported audit ack

eventFamilies.payment: default when the event type is absent; single-URL providers keep delivering here
eventFamilies.refund: event type contains 'refund'; wins over every other marker
eventFamilies.unsupported: payout | dispute | chargeback | balance | transfer | settlement — audited + 200 ack, never applied to a payment attempt

orchestrationSteps: unmapped -> audit warn + accepted ack (no PSP retry storm)

rules: derived attempt scope always wins over caller-supplied scope
multiple attempts matching one webhook identity -> conflict, never an arbitrary pick
organization_id '0' is the platform sentinel and matches only when the expected organization is NULL
pre-verification rejections persist under tenant '0' with a body fingerprint id
identity projection headers (x-sdkwork-tenant-id, X-Tenant-Id, X-Platform, X-User-Id) MUST NOT be read

degradation: an uninstalled fulfillment capability defers (never fails) the webhook: payment + order state are already advanced and a 5xx would make the PSP retry an event that cannot succeed

compensationWorker.role: webhook 失败补偿：认领 pending/processing 支付与 submitted/processing 退款，查询 PSP 状态，以合成事件（query:{provider}:{out_trade_no}:{mapped_status}）复用 notify 积木（幂等/终态保护/履约键）
compensationWorker.idempotency: 合成事件与 webhook 重发同路径：ingest (tenant_id, provider_scoped_event_id) 去重 + 状态机 FOR UPDATE + 履约键；webhook 已成功时 worker 查询成为重放，无重复成功

successProcessing.notificationSource: verified webhook -> persisted exact payment attempt
successProcessing.reconciliationSource: provider query -> verified exact payment attempt
successProcessing.operatorSource: backend payment_confirmations -> reconcile -> same settlement entrypoint
successProcessing.registryParity: the webhook intake and the backend operator confirmation MUST share one PaymentNotifyHandlerRegistry instance
successProcessing.transactionRule: provider I/O happens before the database transaction; exact attempt confirmation uses conditional transactional writes and idempotent replay

forbidden: rebuilding the intake paths in a surface crate
mounting the payment webhook without the refund webhook
two different PaymentNotifyHandlerRegistry instances for webhook and operator confirmation
PSP webhook HTTP handlers in sdkwork-payment (except deprecated 410 shim)
applying an unsupported financial event family to a payment attempt
accepting a caller-supplied tenant/organization scope on a webhook settlement
